A few things you might be wondering

Good questions.
Straight answers.

New to AI? You’re in the right place.

I know I should be doing something with AI. Where do I start?

Start with a task that keeps getting in the way: retyping information, chasing updates or putting reports together. We can look at how that task works today and decide whether AI, a simple connection between systems, or a better process would help.

Do I need to replace all my software?

No. Connecting the systems you already use may be enough. A custom app is an option when the limitations and ongoing costs justify it. We can work out which approach fits your business before committing to a build.

Do you work with tradies and small teams?

Yes. My focus is small businesses, especially trade and service businesses with people in the field and admin to manage back in the office. You don’t need a technical background to get started.

How much does it cost?

It depends on the problem and the scope. A single workflow improvement is a different project from replacing a job management platform. We’ll agree on the work, cost and ongoing support before anything is built.

Can we meet in person?

Yes. I’m based in Melbourne and happy to meet for a coffee to talk through your business. A video call works too.

Will I save $80,000 as well?

That was the annual subscription spend I removed in my own business, not a forecast for yours. Your result depends on the software you use and the work involved. Hosting, AI usage, maintenance and support also need to be included in the decision.
